name: Challenge Overlord Mok'Morokk
summary: In Brackenwall Village, Overlord Mok'Morokk laughs at your challenge and vows to crush you. Draz'Zilb expected you to drive him from the village.

sections.title: A Challenge to the Overlord
sections.body: After The Brood of Onyxia, you face Overlord Mok'Morokk. He laughs at your nerve and promises to crush you. Then he tells you to speak when you are ready for a beating. Draz'Zilb in Brackenwall Village expected you to chase Mok'Morokk from the village. Why have you returned only to talk?

sections.title: Word for Draz'Zilb
sections.body: Draz'Zilb says Mok'Morokk fled like a coward after you won the fight. He thanks you for a great service. With Mok'Morokk gone, the ogres can choose a new leader to help them take back their old home for good.

faq.answer: You challenge Overlord Mok'Morokk in Brackenwall Village. He laughs and boasts that he will crush you.
The Brood of Onyxia comes before your challenge.

faq.q: Who do you report to after the fight?
aliases: who do i turn this in to
where to go after beating mok'morokk
faq.answer: After the fight, you report to Draz'Zilb in Brackenwall Village.

faq.q: What does Draz'Zilb expect of you?
faq.answer: Draz'Zilb expects you to chase Mok'Morokk from the village. He wonders why you returned only to talk.
